title: PriceHistory
description: Price history of one offer (data/history/<provider>/<tld>.json). Append-only: a new entry only when the price state (currency, VAT mode, unit and the stated amounts) changes, dated with the day the new state was first seen (evidence.fetched_at). The last entry always equals the offer's current state (validate-data). A change of currency, price unit or VAT mode is not continued automatically: the scraper and history:sync skip the offer and report it (history:sync exits non-zero), so a person decides. The one exception is a market switch (German display <-> foreign market display, see entry.market): it starts a new segment in the same file. The history starts with the state at its first entry; there is no older data.

amount.description: Integer minor units (cents) of `currency`, as stated by the provider (offer price); null = unknown.

date.description: Day the state was first seen (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of evidence.fetched_at).

vat_included.description: As in the offer: true gross, false net, null no VAT statement.

market.description: Country of a foreign market display (the offer's foreign_market, owner decision 2026-11-19); absent for the German display. A switch between the German display (EUR, gross) and a foreign market display (USD, net) starts a new segment: entries before it belong to the other market and are not comparable with the later ones.

source.description: The offer's evidence when the entry was written (nothing fetched for the history).
